units.text: It creates, reads, and edits PowerPoint .pptx presentations by building the Office Open XML package itself. It adds slides, shapes, text frames, tables, notes slides, and comment authors, and saves presentations to the .pptx format using the SaveFormat.Pptx option.
It creates new presentations, opens existing ones from a path or a stream, saves to a path or a stream, and disposes resources throughout.
It adds empty slides, inserts slides, removes slides, clones slides, hides slides, enumerates slides, masters, and layouts, and manages sections with add, append, remove, and reorder operations.
It adds AutoShapes, picture frames, and connectors bound to shapes by connection site, supports z-order reordering, and adjusts geometry shape values.

It formats text with character properties such as bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, size, spacing, caps, and font selection, and paragraph properties including alignment, indent, margins, spacing, and bullets.

It applies solid, gradient, pattern, picture, and no-fill types to shapes, lines, text portions, and table cells, and configures line width, dash style, caps, joins, miter limit, compound style, alignment, and arrowheads.
It applies outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, and fill overlay effects to shapes.
It creates tables with rows, columns, cells, cell merging, cell fill, borders, cell margins and anchoring, and table style presets.

It manages notes slides with notes text, footer text, footer visibility, and slide-number visibility, and handles comments with authors, positions, timestamps, and document properties in core, extended, and custom XML parts.

This example creates a new presentation, adds a rectangle shape with text to the first slide, saves it as a PPTX file, reopens the file, and prints the slide count, shape count, and text content to the console.

The following workflows demonstrate core tasks with Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET: adding formatted text, inserting tables, applying effects, managing notes and comments, organizing slides into sections, and saving to or loading from streams.
Create a rectangle with centered, bold, colored text.
Build a two-by-two table and merge its top cells.
Apply an outer shadow effect to a colored rectangle.
Add a notes slide and a comment to the first slide.
Create two slides and assign them to named sections.
Save a presentation to a stream and reopen it.

Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET exposes the Aspose.Slides.Foss namespace as its primary entry point, with the Aspose.Slides.Foss.Presentation class serving as the main class for working with presentations. It supports reading and writing Pptx, Ppsx, and Potx formats.

The Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET class is the root namespace for the library and mirrors the naming of the commercial Aspose.Slides for .NET product, so that product's documentation is usually the fastest way to understand what a shared type name means, though this library supports a much smaller subset of the API as documented in the tables above.

That product adds rendering and conversion to PDF, images, HTML, and thumbnails, as well as support for charts, SmartArt, animations, OLE objects, and macro-enabled files, none of which this library implements.
